w:r.w:t: Project Prompt: Build a Universal Open Knowledge Search Engine
Design and build a modern, scalable, AI-powered search engine that helps users discover
knowledge resources from across the internet through a single interface.

The platform should aggregate metadata and links from trusted public and open-access sources instead of hosting copyrighted content. Its purpose is to simplify discovery of books, research papers, journals, theses, magazines, biographies, educational resources, government publications, technical documentation, and other freely available knowledge.
The system should be designed to scale to hundreds of millions of searchable records.
The user should be able to search once and instantly receive results from multiple knowledge sources.
